description:
An order for investigative detention shall be issued only if the judge concludes from the application that:

  1. a crime has been committed and is under active investigation, and
     
  2. there is a reasonable and well-grounded basis from which to believe that the person sought may have committed the crime, and
     
  3. the results of the physical characteristics obtained during the detention will significantly advance the investigation and determine whether or not the individual probably committed the crime, and
     
  4. the physical characteristics sought cannot otherwise practicably be obtained. 

Note: Adopted July 26, 1984 to be effective September 10, 1984.
